title: Offices.
bodyText: The commissioner shall have an office at Honolulu, and may maintain such offices elsewhere in this State as the commissioner may deem necessary.
bodyHtml: §431:2-110  Offices.  The commissioner shall have an office at Honolulu, and may maintain such offices elsewhere in this State as the commissioner may deem necessary. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
